SP leader Akhilesh Yadav announces 27,000‑vote target per constituency for 2027 UP election

On 20 September 2026, Akhilesh Yadav, the head of the Samajwadi Party, told a state executive meeting that the party has prepared a ‘mega plan’ for the 2027 Uttar Pradesh Legislative Assembly election, aiming to secure or shift 27,000 votes in every constituency.
